commits.message: Attempting CI/CD workflow again

Prepare release 1.0.7 to test CI/CD

Add correct versioning, and prepare package for automatic upload attempt

Update versioning

Change to version 1.0.6 for compatibility with testPyPI state. Fast-forward
to sixth patch to catch up production versioning to staging versioning, and
remove inconsistencies.

Create new publishing workflow

Add publishing workflow for test PyPI, PyPI, and GitHub releases. Testpypi workflow runs every time a commit is pushed to main, whereas PyPI and GitHub releases only trigger on tagged pushes (aka real releases).

Use OIDC to connect with both platforms to allow Github Actions to publish releases.

Update python-package.yml

Changed the name.

Create python-publish.yml

Publishes the package to PyPI

Adjust README, add todo

Set final README copy for v1.0, and add TODO to the main module
so I remember to go back and add the final functionality it needs before
launch
Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/jasongarvin/pokewrap

Add requirements.txt

Include requirements.txt for ease of install, dependency management.

Create python-package.yml

Add package validation per GitHub workflows
Adjust readme to current status

Refactor Pokemon wrapper for self-documentation

Adjust how the Pokemon wrapper object works, streamlining the process of
receiving data from the API and building it into easier to work with
chunks within the Pokemon class.

Fixed bugs preventing the dictionary from populating correctly into
Pokemon.content
Extend README to include examples, how to use

Remove need to pass endpoint into object creation

Build API_URI_STUB into the insantiation of both ApiController
and ApiResourceList so the user doesn't have to worry about it.
Now the user can just put in the desired resource and specific
entity (ie "gengar") instead of worrying about setting up the endpoint.

Expand Pokemon class in wrappers

Bring all relevant categories from parsed JSON response dict object
into attributes of the Pokemon wrapper class for ease of access.

Add tests for ApiController

Update documentation for test_api unit test module, and improve
how variables are stored and used throughout the test object.

Add additional tests for more attributes within ApiController.

Add January post and revise 2024 post.

Adjust 2024 post to have accurate metadata (some
parts included artifacts of old posts instead
of the correct information) and revise sitemap
to reflect these changes.

Add January 2025 post and link to it in the
appropriate places.

2025 site update

Adjust content to better match business goals and
current personal branding.

Remove Fill and Fire since I'm no longer affiliated
with the project. Update home page with current
business information, personal goals, clear
language, and better blog post features.

Revise footer to include '2025' since it's 2025.

Add final blog post of 2024

Yes it's late, but at least it's here. The 2024
annual review is live.

Minor copy/design revision pass

The site badly needs a visual upgrade to line up
with my current career goals and abilities.

In the meantime, here's some quick copy updates to
bring the verbiage better in line with my current
career path and goals, plus some minor design
updates for readability and visual appeal.

Add new blog post for June

Build out new blog post and add quick links from
the blog main page and the home page connecting
to it.

Fix the links on the home page because they didn't
properly connect to the blog pages since they
didn't include the blog/ directory.
Merge branch 'main' into blog-posts
Delete CNAME
Delete CNAME

Add links to old blog posts

Add links between relevant blog posts to older posts, ensuring that
posts with related content to other articles I've written correctly
market those articles to readers. Improve language and paragraph
formatting for 2023 in Review post and Habits post.

Add backlinks to pokewrap blog post

Lightly revise my second blog post on publishing pokewrap to read better and include a link to my 2023 year-end review.
Update sitemap with recent changes

Revise habits blog post

Add backlinks and other content to habits post to improve its message, support it with more content, and connect my blog posts better.

Fix issue where habits post had two different "toggle-theme" buttons, leading to a floating button at the top and a nonfunctional button at the bottom.

Build scaffolding for April blog post

Add new page for April blog post, card in blog index, and update sitemap.

Add scaffolding for March blog posts

Adjust and implement templated page for AI blog post. Add content, canonical URL, title, and basic metadata. Begin laying out the page, topics, date, and content.

Build scaffolding for next blog posts

Add blog preview card to blog index and create new page to host the upcoming blog post.

Add animations / styles to home page

Create new animation styles for the home page, including slide-in effects, and apply them throughout the home page.

Refine button styles both for the CTA buttons and for default buttons throughout the site.
Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/jasongarvin/jasongarvin.github.io
Merge branch 'design-tweaks'

Finalize home page additions

Adjust styles and layout of home page to ensure it's an improvement from the last iteration. Prepare home page for going live.

Revise button padding

Expand button padding to make buttons more accessible and visually prominent. Change links in Projects page for better UX (more intuitive navigation rather than a link hidden in a heading).
Update sitemap with new blog post.
Finish first published version of blog post.

Move theme button to footer

Redesign footer to fit theme button to improve page flow and minimize weird floating widgets since they look bad and are distacting.

Change theme button design slightly to fit inside footer more easily.
Merge branch 'main' into blog-posts

Begin scaffolding for January post

Draft out basic framework for January post and fix metadata on other blog posts where necessary (incorrect dates, links). Build basic table of contents and lay out title & head metadata.

Expand buttons and link displays

Use larger amounts of padding to make buttons and links more clickable on mobile devices.

Finalize Pokewrap page design

Refine copy and finish first draft of Pokewrap project page design

Add content to pokewrap product page

Include more technical details and other introductory information for my
pokewrap product page to better highlight the project's goals and
accomplishments.

Footer overhaul

Add links section to footer that contains (home, blog, projects, contact). Change layout for social links. Redesign footer background and layout on mobile and desktop. Change to vertical link lists instead of horizontal lists. Update copyright info on projects pages.

Refactor css

Make minor changes to CSS to enable it to be more extensible and flexible, and make classes (slightly) more generic so they can be used in more places.

Take a step in the direction of allowing CSS files to be cached longer and, therefore, be more stable. This requires certainty that I won't need to keep adding new CSS, since that won't get served properly when longer cache times are used.

Add projects subdirectory

Create new folder for projects, a landing page which will include the official pages for things such as Pokewrap and other published software I create. This may be the precursor to my portfolio, or it may just be a clever way for me to share what I'm doing and microblog about it.
Merge branch 'main' into design-tweaks

Remove old site, updates

Old site code is officially deprecated and no longer exists in the directory. Updates page is also gone based on nonexistent usage and the tediousness of keeping it up to date. Instead, use Threads for updates and link back to my website when appropriate.

Add img dimensions, better alt text

Adjust img dimensions in HTML to be unitless and refer to an aspect ratio instead of exact pixel sizing. Change alt text on some images to provide better semantic meaning to screen-reader users.

Add 2023 Review post to index and add content

Create a listing for my 2023 Review blog post in the blog main page, including an interactive blurb. Begin adding section headers and content to the main blog post, including correcting metadata and adding introductory paragraphs.

Fix formatting issues with the subscription box on the new blog post page due to refactoring on other branches.
Fix formatting on upcoming blog post
Merge branch 'design-tweaks' into blog-posts

Fix attributes on site logo svg

Add accessibility data to svg logo, including role and alt attributes. Propogate changes sitewide.

Fix meta details and formatting inconsistencies across all pages, including how the html for Google Tag Manager is laid out and meta attributes in the head section.
Merge branch 'blog-posts' of https://github.com/jasongarvin/jasongarvin.github.io into blog-posts
Merge branch 'design-tweaks' of https://github.com/jasongarvin/jasongarvin.github.io into design-tweaks

Separate concerns between CSS and JS

Change how JavaScript and CSS target classes/IDs such that classes targeted by JS all start with "js-" prefix, and all IDs targeted by JS are used solely for the JS' purpose and aren't tied to styles. Instead, refactor all styles to be held by classes to free up IDs for use by JS exclusively, where applicable.

Improve design of next blog post

Incorporate upcoming design changes in how the sitewide CSS targets elements, to ensure CSS and JavaScript target different elements/classes and avoid breaking one another if a change is made downstream targeting only JavaScript or CSS but inadvertently changes a class name being used in both places.
Begin staging for year-end blog post

Revise blog styles and meta labels

Add closing / to all meta tags in blog-related pages. Revise table-of-contents style so the chevron rotates when clicked.

Refine accessibility and add roles

Use aria-label and aria-labelledby to better clarify the purpose of certain forms, navigation elements throughout the site. Adjust the subscription box and table of content elements on relevant pages to be more accessible and remove unneccesary properties.

Revise link colors and designs for clarity

Adjust how highlighting behind links in the header work (better alignment) and change color palette for links within the main content section to be more visible in dark mode.

Revise accessibility, styles of blog and home

Change labeling of buttons on home page to be more accessible, removing
unneccesary aria labels that confuse screen readers.

Add aside styling for blog posts for supplemental, non-essential content.
Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/jasongarvin/jasongarvin.github.io
Create CNAME
Delete CNAME
Create CNAME
Delete CNAME

Update README

Include services I'm using to run the "back-end" of my pages site, including formspree, AddToAny, and highlight.js
Revise intro paragraph for first blog post

Rename blog post for SEO

Change the blog post to rank better on Google and feel more engaging to readers.

Introduce breaking change to file name:
how-to-build-effective-habits.html -> harnessing-the-power-of-habits.html

Change all refs to old link to the new link.

Add clipboard icon to "copy code" button

Use font awesome to revise the copy-to-clipboard script so it appends a literal clipboard button rather than just the text "copy code" to better match other websites and improve visual style.
Add github deploy status badge
Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/jasongarvin/jasongarvin.github.io
Update readme to 1.0 status

Add bookmark links to blog headings

Use JavaScript to create links that route to each blog heading in order to allow for easier browsing and link sharing.

TODO: revisit this later and possibly change the functionality to instead save the heading URL & slug to clipboard.

Update blog post metadata

Include content section and published time for the two current blog posts using og meta tags.

Change blog styles on wider displays

Adjust blog styles to contain the whole post in a single bubble instead of breaking it up into smaller bubbles by section, to avoid it feeling like the post is several separate posts instead of feeling like a single, cohesive post.

Add aria active-page labeling to global navigation on the relevant pages.

Fix text alignment in contact page

Change where centered style is applied within the contact page so
the bottom text section doesn't inherit.

Change cascade in stylesheet so media queries address larger screen
from least to biggest, better adhering to the intention behind cascading
styles.

Standardize location and layout of css

Change formatting of main CSS stylesheet to be more consistent, including
proper section headers, better spatial divisions between sections,
more comments, labels, and appropriate descriptions, and more intuitive
organization by arranging items with like items.

Reposition subscribe box on blog pages

Move subscribe box inside main tags and switch blog-post id from
main to the article containing the whole blog post.

Add highlight.js to blog post

Use highlight.js and its crazy magic to style code blocks using
language-appropriate color as though viewing it in an IDE.

Implement new logo

Add new logo as svg code directly into each file, to allow customization
of the logo colors depending on active theme.

Target different elements within the embedded svg to ensure it formats
properly and maintains the right size at different screen resolutions.
Merge branch 'main' into meta-and-semantics

Update sitemap to include new blog post

Add update about new blog post and modify existing metadata to the
current state of the site. Update sitemap to include the new page,
and correct the dates.

Fix minor format issues with code blocks

Adjust code block font scaling to ensure it looks small (without breaking
the line) on mobile but larger on bigger resolutions instead of the
exact opposite, which is how I'd coded it initially.
Merge branch 'main' into meta-and-semantics

Add second blog post entry in blog landing

Link to new blog post in blog index

Add new blog post, code block styles

Add the next blog post, "publishing my first python library,"
and add relevant styles to ensure code blocks display properly at a variety
of screen sizes

Add rel attritube to relevant links

Use nofollow and external rel values for all links that take a user
outside my website and to unrelated resources/pages.

Change name of first blog post and all refs

Adjust the name of my blog post to better reflect its content, change
the linking heirarchy everywhere to match the new filename, and
clean up meta tags on all pages where affected.

Revise first blog post

Change styles, update content, and refine first blog post from the
overcoming inertia series.

Add table of contents and quick navigation throughout post, which is
easily implemented in future posts regardless of number of sections.

Adjust meta in head, add twitter og tags

Change order of meta elements in head of all pages, add theme-color options,
and adjust Open Graph meta tags to include twitter tags and move
all urls references to the new, correct canonicals.

Change scaling using calc, vh for home page

Adjust margin on button-link elements to vary based on viewport height,
ensuring my section navigation within the home page functions nicely and
avoids cutting off (or including) unintended content.

Change header font size to use calc, same as for body text, to render
text better at narrower viewport sizes and avoid titles getting horribly
staggered across several lines.

Fix responsive styles at smaller widths

Adjust how elements resize (especially font sizes) to better
accommodate small screen sizes.

Make subscription form work

Subscription form on home page works now, links to a real endpoint,
and animates in all the intended ways!

TODO: fix styles to ensure readability and accessibility of
the form.
Merge branch 'content-refocus'

Fix on-scroll-animate to unobserve

Add functionality so pageviewObserver unobserves objects after they
animate, reducing the risk for memory leaks and poor performance.

Re-implement delay in element animations for concurrent elements
to make scrolling more dynamic (I swear I'd already implemented this).

Fix form to properly condense elements on desktop

Add flex controls to form in order to ensure the form uses
horizontal space appropriately when applicable
Merge branch 'main' into form-overhaul
